answer.summary: Only failing test is ArchRuleRegistrationTest in shard elk8-6. The ArchUnit registration check reports that the rule TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest#scenario_revisions_repository_access_is_reviewed is not annotated @ArchTest and is not listed in HELPERS, so it never runs. TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest.java is in this change, so the change most likely added that rule without wiring it up. This is deterministic and will repeat on retry. The ERROR JSON parse log at line 1248 is unrelated noise that did not fail the build.
